subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat message reuse ship as the four-action long-press surface in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100879, or should the implementation be narrowed before landing?
rationale: Current main clearly lacks the behavior, but the requested Share and Reply actions are a UX/product scope choice rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Land the four-action host
options.body: Approve the Copy, Select text, Share, and Reply action set in the linked PR after review and device/emulator proof.

options.title: Narrow to copy/select
options.body: Ask the PR to ship only Copy and Select text now, leaving Share and Reply for a separate UX decision.

options.title: Defer Android message actions
options.body: Keep the issue open without landing the PR if maintainers want a broader chat interaction design first.

recommendation.title: Land the four-action host
recommendation.body: Approve the Copy, Select text, Share, and Reply action set in the linked PR after review and device/emulator proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the issue and owns the active target-repo implementation candidate.
